title: gurania cissoides
intro: Gurania cissoides, commonly known as the Cissoid Gurania or Cissoid Passionflower, is a species of flowering plant in the passionflower family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its potential to treat anxiety, insomnia, and pain. The therapeutic actions of Gurania cissoides are attributed to its ability to act as a sedative, anxiolytic, and analgesic, which is a result of its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. Research on the plant has identified its potential to modulate the central nervous system, contributing to its therapeutic effects.
